what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Ecuador, as estimated by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 316000 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence.
UNHCR's file reports no internally displaced people for Ecuador; in UNHCR's data that can mean none, or none reported.

why.text: The sources here don't record the causes of this displacement: there are no dated events or armed conflicts for Ecuador in them.
Floods, storms, earthquakes and wildfires are the disasters recorded for Ecuador in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures for people in displacement start in 2024 at 48593 and reach 316000 in 2025.
IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict in 2025.

how.text: IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
Refugees from Ecuador live mainly in the United States.
The sources don't say where inside Ecuador people moved to.
